messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — smoke test for samplekit's toolcall path is flaking on schema validation in the TS SDK when the auth/retry middleware replays the request.
kevin: repro steps?
maria: run `yarn test:smoke --filter toolcall-schema` on node 18. Repro attached.
maria: failing error: `ValidationError: expected object, got string` on analyzer tool output
kevin: can you paste the raw model output? suspect double-encoded JSON on retry
maria: sure:
```
{"tool_call": "{\"name\":\"analyze\",\"args\":\"{\\\"text\\\":\\\"foo\\\"}\"}"}
```
kevin: ahhh — tool_call.args is a stringified JSON inside JSON. JSON mode should return a nested object not a string.
sam: this is what the router/retry flow does: our retry wrapper re-serializes the response body after a 502 and the SDK's JSON-mode parser ends up with a raw string. Py SDK handles it because it runs an extra json.loads step in the fncall helper.
maria: @kevin any quick fix?
kevin: I can patch the TS SDK to detect stringified JSON and attempt a parse before schema validation. But I'd prefer to make the retry middleware preserve the original typed payload instead of reserializing.
devex-bot: ci-bot: smoke: toolcall-schema • failed on macos-latest (logs: https://ci/1234)
kevin: creating PR with defensive parse + unit test. will also add an integration smoke for retry cases. PR: https://git/repo/pull/789
aaron: note: we should emit a telemetry flag when we auto-parse so we can find real model outputs vs router-induced issues.
maria: agreed. added to PR comments.
kevin: merged fix in main, rolled out to canary. please re-run smoke tests.
maria: re-ran — ✅ tests green now. thanks!
sam: leaving a note for onboarding guide: add a section "When JSON-mode returns strings" with recommended SDK behavior and examples.
maria: filed DOCS-445 for that.
kevin: thx all :shipit:
